metaTitle: Custom Men's Lanyards & Badges - Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom men's lanyards & badges for your team. Durable, professional designs at Perfect Imprints. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Men's lanyards and badges are built for durability and a professional look, with wider straps and sturdy hardware that withstand daily wear. Whether you need them for trade show staff, office ID badges, or event security, these lanyards offer a clean, masculine aesthetic. Choose from nylon, polyester, or woven materials and add your logo with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation. They pair well with metal or plastic badge holders for a complete, polished solution.
heroAltText: Custom men's lanyards and badges with logo, featuring durable nylon strap and metal clip
